drafter.private_reasoning: Strengthen the agreement for Delmar by conditioning payment on execution and dismissal, obtaining a broad release, and adding customary confidentiality exceptions. Remove the internal image alt-text before sending; do not disclose privileged information.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is Delmar’s revised draft. We have clarified the payment mechanics, release, dismissal, and customary confidentiality exceptions to help move the settlement toward execution. Please let us know if you have comments.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date, Defendant shall pay Plaintiff the Settlement Amount of $[Settlement Amount], by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff’s counsel. “Effective Date” means the date this Agreement has been executed by all Parties.
edits.name: Payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE AND DISMISSAL. In consideration of the payment described in Section 1, Plaintiff, on behalf of itself and its past and present agents, representatives, successors, and assigns, fully and irrevocably releases Defendant and its past and present parents, subsidiaries, affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, successors, and assigns from any and all claims, demands, liabilities, and causes of action, whether known or unknown, that Plaintiff has or may have arising out of or relating to the facts or claims asserted, or that could have been asserted, in the action through the Effective Date. Within five (5) business days after receiving payment, Plaintiff shall file a dismissal with prejudice of the action, with each Party bearing its own fees and costs. This release does not extend to obligations created by this Agreement.
edits.name: Release and dismissal

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The Parties shall keep confidential the existence and terms of this Agreement, except that a Party may disclose them to its attorneys, accountants, insurers, auditors, and other professional advisers who are bound by confidentiality obligations, or as reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement or comply with law, court order, or regulatory obligation. A Party required to disclose shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other Party prompt notice and reasonably cooperate in seeking confidential treatment. Nothing in this Section prohibits disclosures otherwise required by law.
edits.name: Confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This Agreement and the payment made under it are a compromise of disputed claims and do not constitute an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or the validity of any claim by Defendant. Neither this Agreement nor any negotiation relating to it may be offered as evidence of liability, except in a proceeding to enforce this Agreement or as otherwise required by law.
edits.name: No admission
